title: An exact certificate-based enumeration of Rolle words of degree six

definitions.name: x2611_15505_word_multiplicities
definitions.notes: Labels are derivative orders 0,...,n-1, occurring n,n-1,...,1 times; the total length is N=n(n+1)/2.

definitions.name: x2611_15505_formal_word
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15505_formal_word (n : ℕ) (w : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  x2611_15505_word_multiplicities n w ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < n →
    w.filter (fun k => k = j ∨ k = j + 1) =
      (List.replicate (n - j - 1) [j, j + 1]).flatten ++ [j]
definitions.notes: For each adjacent derivative order, the restricted word alternates j,j+1,...,j. This is precisely the linear extension condition (1), with the occurrence index identifying the root index.

definitions.name: x2611_15505_realizes
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15505_realizes (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℝ) (w : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  p ≠ 0 ∧ p.natDegree = n ∧ x2611_15505_word_multiplicities n w ∧
  ∃ x : Fin w.length → ℝ, StrictMono x ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < n →
      ((Polynomial.derivative : Polynomial ℝ → Polynomial ℝ)^[j] p).roots =
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin w.length => w.get i = j)).val.map x
definitions.notes: A strictly increasing list of all derivative roots is labeled by w. Equality of root multisets, together with the degree and multiplicities, enforces splitting and simplicity of every nonconstant derivative and excludes shared roots. Reversal is not quotiented out.

definitions.name: x2611_15505_ordered_roots
definitions.notes: An increasing enumeration of every root of a degree-m real polynomial, counting multiplicities. For m>0 this is exactly strict hyperbolicity plus the chosen ordering.

definitions.name: x2611_15505_R
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15505_R (u r : ℝ) : Polynomial ℝ :=
  (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C u) * Polynomial.X *
    (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 1) *
    (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (1 + u + 2 * r))
definitions.notes: The normalized quartic R=P″ in (10), with T=1+u+2r.

definitions.name: x2611_15505_F
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15505_F (u r : ℝ) : Polynomial ℝ :=
  Polynomial.C (1 / 30 : ℝ) * Polynomial.X ^ 6 -
  Polynomial.C ((1 + r) / 10) * Polynomial.X ^ 5 -
  Polynomial.C ((u ^ 2 + u + 2 * u * r - 2 * r - 1) / 12) * Polynomial.X ^ 4 +
  Polynomial.C (u * (1 + u + 2 * r) / 6) * Polynomial.X ^ 3
definitions.notes: The normalized sextic primitive F from (12), with the printed definitions of H and T substituted. A normalized P is F-qX+C.

statements.label: Lemma 2.1
statements.name: x2611_15505_lem2_1
statements.original:
A word with multiplicities $n,n-1,\ldots,1$ encodes a linear extension of
(1) if and only if every prefix satisfies

 $0\leq c_{j}-c_{j+1}\leq 1\qquad(0\leq j<n-1).$ 

(2)
statements.lean:
(n : ℕ) (w : List ℕ) (hw : x2611_15505_word_multiplicities n w) :
  x2611_15505_formal_word n w ↔
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ w.length → ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < n →
    0 ≤ ((w.take k).count j : ℤ) - ((w.take k).count (j + 1) : ℤ) ∧
    ((w.take k).count j : ℤ) - ((w.take k).count (j + 1) : ℤ) ≤ 1
statements.notes: Every prefix is w.take k with 0≤k≤length. Integer subtraction preserves the printed lower bound; natural truncated subtraction would lose it. Formal words encode the linear extensions of (1) by alternating restrictions for adjacent labels.
